description: Read per-question results for one job’s LMS quizzes, counted from each person’s FIRST submitted attempt at each quiz version (employer review remediation excluded; later mastery runs never read as skips). One group per course, lesson and quiz version (courseTitle, moduleTitle, lessonTitle, formVersionNumber, peopleCount); per question: grading AUTO | MANUAL | UNGRADED, counts { CORRECT, INCORRECT, PARTIAL, SKIPPED, AWAITING_GRADE, NOT_GRADED }, correctPercent, options (choice pick counts with the correct choice marked) and missedBy (who got it wrong, partly right or skipped it, with their answer). Names are always masked "First L.". audience HIRED (default) reads hired workers; APPLICANT reads application-stage screening quizzes. Optional courseId narrows to one course. Capped at 5000 attempts (truncated=true when reached). Requires lms:read.
name: opentrain_lms_question_results
